simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to טוֹפָפָה (H2903) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: טוֹפָפָה (ṭôwphâphâh) means a fillet for the forehead First listed occurrence: Deut 6 8.

definitions.full: H2903. totaphoth טוֺטָפוֺת noun feminine plural bands (Late Hebrew טוֺטֶפֶת Aramaic טוֺטֶפְתָּא and especially plural טוטפין id. ) — always bands, frontlet-bands, between the eyes (|| יד על אוֺת ; compare עֵינֶיךָ בֵּין זִכָּרוֺן Exod 13:9 || id. ); figurative of dedication of firstborn עיניך בין לְטוֺטָפֹת ֗֗֗ וְהָיָה 13:16 (JE); of commandments of לְטו ׳וְהָיוּ ׳י, Deut 11:18 and לְטֹטָפת וְהָיוּ 6:8 . — This injunction, originally figurative for perpetual remembrance (otherwise Kn, and Klein l.c. 666 ff. , see above, Benz Archaeology 111 Now Archaeology i. 134 ), was taken literally by later Jews, and hence the custom of wearing phylacteries ; see Di (on Exod 13:16 ) Winer RE Ri HWB (article Denkzettel ) Smith Dict.
